item.description: BRANSON, Mo. — A mistrial was declared this week in a Taney County double-murder case after jurors told the court they were “hopelessly deadlocked” and unable to reach a unanimous verdict following four days of deliberations. item.title: Arctic cold grips the Ozarks before gradual warm-up
item.description: Temperatures are expected to be brutally cold tonight, with wind chills potentially dropping into the negatives, and an arctic air mass will reestablish itself on Monday, bringing temperatures in the 20s and wind chills in the single digits, before conditions begin to normalize on Tuesday.

item.title: Arctic attack to start the week, another to finish and it may come with snow
item.description: Another arctic attack is sweeping in from the north, bringing frigid temperatures and snow flurries for the third year in a row on MLK Day, followed by a mid-week warmup and another blast of frigid air by the end of the week.
